_about: AH-64D procedures and how George works, for the co-pilot's answers (source: DCS AH-64D manual, George AI chapter, and this program's checklists). Add your own entries in the same format; 'say' is spoken as written.

entries.title: George rules of engagement
entries.text: George starts in weapons hold. In hold he sets up the shot and waits for your consent: say fire, send it or cleared hot. In weapons free he fires on his own as soon as he is ready, so only give him a weapon when you mean him to shoot.
entries.say: I start in weapons hold and wait for your consent. Say weapons free and I'll shoot on my own when ready.

entries.title: Consent to fire
entries.text: Fire, send it, cleared hot, cleared to fire and shoot only count as the whole sentence, and only within 3 seconds of saying it.
entries.say: Say fire, send it or cleared hot as the whole sentence. It's good for three seconds.

entries.title: Gun engagement range
entries.text: George engages with the gun within 2,500 metres on his own. Your consent to fire lets him engage out to 4,200 metres.
entries.say: With the gun I engage inside 2,500 metres on my own, out to 4,200 with your consent.

entries.title: Rockets
entries.text: George doesn't fire rockets. With rockets selected he tracks the target and zooms; you fire them in cooperative mode.
entries.say: I don't fire rockets. I'll track and zoom, you fire them in co-op.

entries.title: Hellfire LOBL and LOAL
entries.text: LOBL, lock-on before launch, works only with the direct trajectory. Low and high trajectories need LOAL, lock-on after launch. Say LOBL, LOAL, or trajectory high, low or direct.
entries.say: LOBL only with direct trajectory. Low and high trajectories need LOAL.

entries.title: Hellfire types, SAL and RF
entries.text: SAL Hellfires are laser guided: the laser must stay on the target until impact. RF Hellfires are radar guided and fire and forget. When one missile type runs out, George switches to the other loaded type. Say switch to RF or switch to SAL.
entries.say: SAL needs the laser on the target until impact. RF is fire and forget. When one type runs out I switch to the other.

entries.title: Searching for targets
entries.text: Say search and George slaves the TADS to your helmet sight, searches there and reads out his target list with clock positions. Search again repeats along the TADS line of sight. Forward area, helmet area, FCR targets and PFZ are the area searches.
entries.say: Say search and I'll look where you're looking, then read you the list. Search again repeats along my line of sight.

entries.title: Point search
entries.text: Say point search and a TSD point, for example point search tango zero seven. George slaves the TADS to that point and searches around it. Target, control measure, waypoint and hazard points work.
entries.say: Say point search and the point, like tango zero seven. I'll slave there and search.

entries.title: Shoot list
entries.text: Say engage targets 1, 3 and 4, or engage targets one through four. George marks them on his shoot list and engages them in that order. Skip target moves on to the next one.
entries.say: Say engage targets and the numbers. I put them on the shoot list and take them in order.

entries.title: Cease fire
entries.text: Cease fire, hold fire, check fire or stand down: George stops every task, including engagements, and fixes the TADS forward.
entries.say: Cease fire stops everything I'm doing and fixes the TADS forward.

entries.title: Power lever positions
entries.text: Power levers: off when shut down, idle for engine start and cool-down, fly for flight. Both levers go to fly once the engines are stable at idle.
entries.say: Off shut down, idle for start and cool-down, fly for flight once both engines are stable.

entries.title: Cool-down before shutdown
entries.text: Before shutdown, set the parking brake, flares safe, power levers to idle and cool down for two minutes, then power levers off.
entries.say: Power levers idle, two minutes cool-down, then off.

entries.title: Countermeasures before take-off
entries.text: Before take-off: CMWS on and flares armed. After landing: flares safe.
entries.say: CMWS on and flares armed before take-off. Flares safe after landing.

entries.title: George start-up and shutdown
entries.text: On the ground, a long press of the multifunctional input (more than a second) makes George do his CPG start-up or shutdown.
entries.say: On the ground, hold the multifunctional input for a second and I'll do my start-up or shutdown.

entries.title: Threat warnings
entries.text: Say toggle threat warnings to turn George's spoken threat warnings on or off.
entries.say: Say toggle threat warnings to turn my threat calls on or off.
